info.name: QuixDevs Stripe REST Payments
info.description: Development build: authenticated native order-pay handoff and status. authentication is the complete backend-only Authorization header value; use a scoped test account. Never export real credentials.

request.description: Requires HTTPS and owner identity or both integration grants. No guest access. Keep authorization and payment URLs confidential.

exec: pm.test("Expected success or documented authorization/payment error", function () { pm.expect([200,202,400,401,403,404,409,413,422,502,503]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
pm.test("Response never contains client secret or secret key", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).not.to.match(/client_secret|sk_live_|sk_test_/); });
